species.name: Crappie
why: Water 52°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–22 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 52°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–32 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.
South wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
